It has 9 types. `OwnerRepository` extends Spring Data's `JpaRepository<Owner, Integer>`, its methods use `Owner`, `Page`, `Pageable` and `Optional`, and three controllers hold it as a `private final owners` field set through the constructor. Members are shown only where they involve `OwnerRepository` directly.

    }

    }

        <<Entity>>

        -String telephone
        -List~Pet~ pets
        +getPets() List~Pet~
        +addPet(Pet pet)

    }

    class Optional~T~ {
        <<java.util>>
    }

    class OwnerController {
        <<Controller>>
        -OwnerRepository owners
        +OwnerController(OwnerRepository owners)
        +findOwner(Integer ownerId) Owner
        +processCreationForm(Owner owner, BindingResult result, RedirectAttributes ra) String
        +processFindForm(int page, Owner owner, BindingResult result, Model model) String
        +processUpdateOwnerForm(Owner owner, BindingResult result, int ownerId, RedirectAttributes ra) String
        +showOwner(int ownerId) ModelAndView
        -findPaginatedForOwnersLastName(int page, String lastname) Page~Owner~

    class PetController {
        <<Controller>>
        -OwnerRepository owners
        -PetTypeRepository types
        +PetController(OwnerRepository owners, PetTypeRepository types)
        +findOwner(int ownerId) Owner
        +findPet(int ownerId, Integer petId) Pet
        +processCreationForm(Owner owner, Pet pet, BindingResult result, RedirectAttributes ra) String
        +processUpdateForm(Owner owner, Pet pet, BindingResult result, RedirectAttributes ra) String
    }

    class VisitController {
        <<Controller>>
        -OwnerRepository owners
        +VisitController(OwnerRepository owners)
        +loadPetWithVisit(int ownerId, int petId, Map model) Visit

    }
